candidates.source_description:
Eligible households in parts of Australia can access three hours of free electricity each day under schemes designed to make better use of abundant solar generation. Victoria’s Midday Power Saver began on October 1, following the Solar Sharer Offer introduced in New South Wales, South Australia and South East Queensland on July 1.
